prompt: a laptop Chris Cooley drew frame by frame in 2015 (kept by the Wayback Machine, 23 April 2015), rebuilt as an arcade toy in Fizlet from the same sprite sheet: tap and the lid slams open; every tap of the keys sprays code, lights the screen and scrolls the code on; the screen's button slams it shut
title: The laptop slams open and sprays code as you type (2015, arcade)
author: chris-cooley
